==Ingredients==
* [[Cookbook:Spelt|Spelt]]
* [[Cookbook:Leek|Leek]]
* [[Cookbook:Oatmeal|Oat flakes]]
* [[Cookbook:Onion|Onions]]
* [[Cookbook:Cumin|Cumin]]
* [[Cookbook:Chiles|Chillies]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

==Procedure==
# Grind the spelt coarsely (if you have entire corns).
# Soak the spelt with oat flakes in some water, in order to get a viscous substance. The burgers will be more compact if you add more oat flakes. 
# Cut onions and leek in small pieces.
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] onions and leek with some oil.
# Mix the substance with onions, leek and spices of your choice (cumin is a good choice).
# Form flat burgers in a hot, oiled pan.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* The burgers are also quite tasty when they are cold and on the next day.

== See also ==

* [[Cookbook:Bean Spelt Oat Spread|Bean Spelt Oat Spread]]
* [[Cookbook:Hamburger|Hamburger]]
